definition: Scores ≤4 suggest minimal depression which may not require treatment.
Scores 5-9 suggest mild depression which may require only watchful waiting and repeated PHQ-9 at followup. Please consult your nearest healthcare facility for further information.
Scores 10-14 suggest moderate depression severity; please consult your nearest healthcare facility for further information.
Scores 15-19 suggest moderately severe depression, please seek medical attention from your nearest healthcare facility.
Scores 20 and greater suggest severe depression; please seek medical attention from your nearest healthcare facility.
